items.quote: OAuth is for if you're building a public app that accesses other people's Intercom data.
items.why: States OAuth for public apps only; says nothing about bearer_token.

items.quote: you are required to set up OAuth.
items.why: Says OAuth is required; does not name bearer_token or the public-app scope.

items.quote: simply provide it as an `Authorization:Bearer` header in your requests
items.why: States the Bearer header method only; oauth2 half of the claim is unsupported.

items.quote: Development workspaces are free and intended for development purposes only.
items.why: Quote covers free dev workspaces and their limits; says nothing about admin approval.

items.quote: This API reference is auto-generated from an OpenAPI specification.
items.why: Confirms OpenAPI generation only; no REST, resource-group breadth, or regional hosts.

items.quote: Intercom hosts a remote MCP server that follows the authenticated remote MCP specification
items.why: Intercom hosts a remote MCP server per the spec; existence and vendor ownership stated. URL not in quote.
